description: Developed VBA tools leveraging Autodesk Inventor models to automate cable measurement, improving bid accuracy and material planning. Recovered a FANUC CNC system without OEM documentation, eliminating contractor dependency and restoring production stability. Managed $50K–$300K+ per project in parts, services and equipment while modernizing systems to meet machinery safety standards. Worked directly with clients on welding equipment designs valued at $100K–$400K and engineered PLC‑based automation systems in high‑heat refinery environments for reliable temperature acquisition and custom signal integration.
highlights: Automated cable measurement & improved bid accuracy
Recovered FANUC CNC & eliminated contractor dependency
Engineered PLC automation in high‑heat refinery environments
